Initial release of evidence-chain-builder (LGD-II 有证):

- Provides evidence chain evaluation for AI claims, marking evidence source type, verifiability, and credibility.
- Does not judge claim truth; focuses strictly on assessing evidence quality.
- Flags unverifiable or assertion-based evidence and clearly indicates when insufficient evidence exists.
- Supports command-line usage with flexible input formats for claims and evidence.
- Output includes evidence validity assessment and lists unsupported claims.
- Documentation available in Chinese, with clear use cases and installation instructions.
